text:
Sam: Quick deploy ping — planning canary rollout for model-serving v3.2 today at 16:00 UTC. Need a roll owner, smoke checks list, and rollback ready. Target cohorts: 1% global -> 5% -> 20% over 30m intervals. Who can own the 16:00 window?
Maria: I can lead the roll. I'll handle the 1% -> 5% bump and monitor for 30m. @Denise can you take 20% ramp watch?
Denise: Yep, I'll cover the 20% watch and can be oncall until +2h. Will look at error-rate, p95 latency, and tail OOMs.
Kai: Heads-up: infra autoscaler has a cooldown of 10m for that cluster — might affect burst. We'll keep spike headroom at +2 nodes.
Sam: Thanks. Smoke checklist (short):
- deploy-bot: run smoke
- query /health and /v1/generate quick sample
- check p50/p95 latency dashboard
- verify token usage not spiking
- tail logs for KV cache errors
Maria: deploy-bot, can you kick the smoke job once we unfreeze the release?
deploy-bot: Scheduling smoke job: test-smoke-v3.2 at 16:05 UTC. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/smoke/2445678900
Leo: I'll run the test prompts and validate output quality for the sampled prompts. Quick QA script I run:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-3.2","prompt":"Summarize: <sample>"}' | jq .choices[0].text
```
Maria: Plan for ramp: 1% for 10m, evaluate signoffs (Maria,Denise,Leo), then 5% for 10m, then 20% for 30m. If error-rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 800ms -> rollback.
Denise: A couple quick checks I'll watch: 5xxs by endpoint, memory OOMs in runtime-exec, kv-cache-miss spikes.
Kai: Rollback command (if needed):
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --service=model-serving --to-version=3.1 --reason=\"canary-failure\"
```
Sam: Good. Who will trigger rollback? Maria: I'll trigger and announce, but Kai can assist with the cluster-level steps.
Sam: Notification plan: post updates here every bump+final. If rollback, tag #incidents and page SRE.
Leo: QA quick note: will flag any hallucination regressions in the sample set. If >3/20 failures we hold.
Maria: All set from product. I'll start the window at 16:00 UTC. Please be available 15:55-17:30 :thumbsup:
Denise: I'll be online. ping me on DM if something odd.
Kai: I'll watch infra and scaling, and will be ready to flip the autoscaler if needed.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 16:00 UTC. Bump schedule: 1%->5%->20%. Monitor URL: https://ops.redwood/internal/rollouts/2445678900
Sam: Thanks team — I'll post a short postmortem if anything unexpected comes up.
Maria: If everything stable at 20% for 30m, we'll continue incremental increase later today. :rocket:
